derivedFiles.purpose: Public entry point and original GrokAuthPlugin / _internal exports
Provider identity, CLI reference source and original timing constants
Unchanged CLI discovery, real installed version detection, service headers and cancellable response reads
CLI-owned home/scope/identity references, device OAuth and original single-flight renewal queue; no credential copies or stale-token fallback
Responses request parameters, fail-closed web-access restrictions, cancellable forwarding and kept sign-in responses
Default and live model catalogs with context-window variants and CLI reference reads
Cancellable subscription usage and original shared rate-limit state; no auth persistence
Plugin factory, two reference-only CLI methods, explicit storage metadata and public hooks

localChanges.purpose: web_search and web_search_preview external_web_access=false return local HTTP 400 unsupported_external_web_access before credential renewal or upstream fetch; the restriction is never silently removed

CLI OAuth success stores only source=grok-cli, home, selected scope and accountId. Each operation rereads that scope and verifies the account identity; access/refresh tokens and torn-read caches are not stored or used as fallback

CPA JSON import method 2 is unavailable. Supporting explicit manual imports requires preserving the original Auth fields plus scope in the host encrypted store and renewal without creating another plaintext home/auth.json. No CPA file is read or copied here
Browser method 0 runs only the existing real CLI login --device-auth in its own home; the CLI alone creates/writes auth.json. No plugin credential homes or credential-file writes remain

Client headers use the exact detected installed CLI version, including older versions. Missing or unreadable versions fail with an installation/readability instruction; no higher hardcoded fallback or automatic install is used

Optional AbortSignal propagates through CLI-file reads, torn-read retries, version detection, OAuth waiting and cancellation, shared renewal waiting, fetch and response body reads; one cancelled waiter does not stop a renewal joined by others

hostReadOnly.operations: token reads only the saved CLI home/scope, checks accountId and expiry, and fails on a rejected unchanged token. No automatic grok models call, renewal queue or CLI credential-file write remains
hostReadOnly.ensure: auth.ensure(snapshot, info, {getAuth, force, signal}) rereads the live selected host reference before and after the real CLI-file read, compares the complete reference, and returns only the stored pure reference. force rechecks without rotating; a changed token must already have been provided by the original CLI
hostReadOnly.maintenance: The factory no longer registers auth.refresh or refreshLead; metadata.refresh=false. The import-compatible refreshAuth entry reports grok_local_refresh_unsupported without invoking the CLI
hostReadOnly.explicitLogin: Existing signIn device OAuth, current authorize, callback scope selection, and exact installed CLI version detection are preserved. Only an explicitly requested CLI login may write the CLI-owned auth.json
hostReadOnly.provenancePolicy: Original repository, commit, package, derivedFiles and localChanges entries are preserved as historical provenance; this section records the current host read-only override
